title: Inventory Presets
description: Save your inventory layouts and load them!
body:
**Inventory Presets** lets you save and load inventory slots with a single click or hotkey.

## Features

- **Multiple Presets** — Create, rename, edit, reorder, and manage as many presets as you need from the Presets tab.
- **Save & Load** — Save your current inventory with a button. Load the selected preset with the Load button or press **J** — every item moves to the exact slot it was saved in.
- **Works Everywhere** — Loading uses ordinary inventory clicks, so it works in survival on any server. In creative, presets restore instantly and exactly — even items you don't currently have.
- **Settings Menu** — Press **~** to open a tabbed settings screen: **Settings** for capture toggles, **Presets** for preset management, and **Miscellaneous** for toasts, sounds, and other sutff.
- **Single Preset Mode** — Prefer the simplicity of one preset? Toggle this on in the Presets tab and the save button will always overwrite your current preset.
- **Drop Items Not In Preset** — Optional: items your preset get dropped on load. Off by default and.

All presets and settings are saved to disk and persist across sessions. Client-side only — no server mod required.
